mainEntity.name: How much does property photography cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property shoots start at £150 for a 1-hour session, £350 for 2 hours and £695 for 4 hours, with multi-property and multi-day projects at £1,520 per day. The right option depends on the size of the property and how many spaces need covering — a free 20-minute consultation will give you a clear recommendation and quote.

Coventry, Warwickshire and the wider West Midlands — including Leamington Spa, Warwick, Kenilworth, Rugby, Nuneaton, Stratford-upon-Avon, Solihull and Birmingham. Travel beyond 15 miles from CV4 is charged at £1 per mile.

mainEntity.name: How many photos will I get, and how soon?

acceptedAnswer.text: The number depends on the property and brief — enough to show every key space well. Images are professionally edited and delivered in web-ready and high-resolution folders. Shorter 1–2 hour shoots are usually delivered within 24 hours; larger 4–8 hour shoots within 48–72 hours.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the images on Rightmove, Booking.com and my own website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Images are licensed for your marketing use across listings portals (Rightmove, Zoopla, Booking.com, Airbnb), your own website, brochures and social media.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle tricky interior lighting and bright windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — this is where professional experience matters most. Balancing bright windows against darker interiors so a room looks natural and accurate is a core part of property work, and is handled on every shoot.

mainEntity.name: Do you photograph occupied and furnished properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Furnished and occupied properties photograph very well with a little preparation — tidy surfaces, open blinds and clear clutter. The pre-shoot brief covers what helps each space look its best.

mainEntity.name: Do you photograph B&Bs, hotels and holiday lets as well as homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — hospitality is a core part of the work, alongside residential. Guest rooms, communal areas, bars, dining rooms and exteriors for B&Bs, hotels, guest houses, Airbnb and holiday lets.
